title: tools: Remove convert_proto_tree_add_text.pl and convert_expert_add_info_format.pl
description:
These are perl scripts that shouldn't need converting to Python.
These conversion tools came out before Wireshark v2.0 to help convert use of proto_tree_add_text and expert_add_info_format when both didn't have filterable items.  At this point the tools shouldn't be needed unless there is a really old third-party dissector in the wild.

AI-Assisted: no
